storage_design: content-addressed minute partitions referenced by existing archive; no parallel report archive
universe: immutable full requested watchlist; every symbol has DATA_AVAILABLE or explicit DATA_MISSING reason
normalization: timezone-aware ascending timestamp; identical duplicate dedup; conflicting duplicate fail closed
coverage: authoritative session plus approved provider minute/auction grid; no synthetic forward fill; absent/no-trade/provider-outage distinguished
revision: append-only content identity; changed source requires new revision and predecessor digest; same semantic input is idempotent
replay: explicit as_of; bar availability <= as_of; chronological input; immutable calendar/source digests
retention: minute OHLCV retained long-term in compressed columnar partitions; raw provider payload retention and backup policy require activation review

inputs: previous authoritative session close with provenance
explicit nonnegative absolute flat_band with approved parameter version

rules.OPEN_LOW_RISE: open < previous_close - flat_band AND final_close > open + flat_band
rules.OPEN_HIGH_FALL: open > previous_close + flat_band AND final_close < open - flat_band

actual_trend.interpretation: labels describe open-to-end net movement, not a monotonic path or predictive skill; equality belongs to the flat band
actual_trend.incomplete: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never classify missing input as SIDEWAYS
actual_trend.evaluation: chronological replay using the same stored bars; freeze parameter version before split; preserve confusion/coverage by session; never tune on production outcomes

activation_prerequisites: Verify deployed Shioaji version numeric timestamp semantics against provider evidence; no guessed 8-hour shift
Approve minute timestamp start/end convention and closing-auction/no-trade grid
Approve OHLCV volume unit and adjustment semantics
Approve flat-band parameter value/version and raw retention policy
Prove full-watchlist retrieval without relaxing historical admission or adding a scheduler
